headlines.description: Preparations are underway for the return of Christmas in the Park to downtown San Jose for the holiday season. When everything is set up, visitors can look forward to hundreds of decorated Christmas trees and animated displays. The holiday celebration has been running for more than four decades. It will be open daily from Nov. 27 through Jan. 1.
